# Vendored upstream

- Repository: `https://github.com/ayanami770/Universal-TUI`
- Commit: `419fef2e89e68873fe969ecbdb02d8cfa2331ba3`
- Vendored on: 2026-08-09

The repository was private at vendoring time. This directory contains the
upstream `utui.c`, `utui.h`, `README.md`, and `LICENSE` without source changes.
It is compiled as a distinct strict ISO C99 static library by the top-level
CMake project.

When the upstream repository becomes public, this directory can be replaced by
a git submodule at the same path and pinned commit.
